Hi Abe — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is an initial engagement outline (mutual roadmap) that captures the milestones, tentative owners, dependencies, and two target-close options. High level: 

- Milestones (draft):
  1) Security & compliance review (SOC evidence review) — target owner: Brightshore security team
  2) Proof-of-concept (POC) deployment & perf validation — target owner: Redwood solutions
  3) Pilot data ingest & evaluation — target owner: Brightshore data team
  4) Contract & commercial sign-off — target owner: Brightshore procurement

- Dependencies called out: KMS access for test environment, network egress rules, and a 1-week test data window (we'll provide a scrubbed sample).

- Timeline options (pick one):
  Option A — Accelerated: POC kickoff next week, pilot complete by 2026-06-25, target close by 2026-06-30
  Option B — Standard: POC in 2 weeks, pilot complete by 2026-07-20, target close by 2026-07-31

Ask: please confirm the internal stakeholder roster (we've listed names below) and indicate which timeline you prefer. If any milestone owners should be swapped or if there are additional gates we missed, flag them and we'll update.

Attached: BRIGHTSHORE_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (initial worksheet with milestone rows).

Proposed next meeting: 30-minute check next Tue or Wed to lock owners and confirm test data schedule. What works for your team?

Thanks — Ben
